```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

Residual DSEM (RDSEM; Asparouhov & Muthen, 2020) separates contemporaneous
structural regressions and time trends from autoregressive dynamics on the
within-level residual process ($y_{t} = \alpha + \beta x_t + \hat{y}_t$,
$\hat{y}_t = \phi \hat{y}_{t-1} + \epsilon_t$).

`DSEMr` represents residual dynamics explicitly in both `lavaan` syntax
(`y ~ residual(lag(y, 1)) + x`) and Mplus caret syntax (`y^ ON y^1; y ON x;`).

```{r}
library(DSEMr)

set.seed(2020)
n <- 120
x <- rnorm(n)
u <- numeric(n)
u[1] <- rnorm(1)
for (t in 2:n) u[t] <- 0.55 * u[t - 1] + rnorm(1, sd = 0.6)
dat <- data.frame(time = seq_len(n), x = x, y = 0.5 + 1.2 * x + u)

m_rdsem <- dsem_model("y ~ residual(lag(y, 1)) + x", time = "time")
fit_rdsem <- dsem(m_rdsem, dat, chains = 2, iter = 300, warmup = 150, seed = 2020)
coef(fit_rdsem)
```

Equivalent Mplus syntax compiles to the identical canonical model:

```{r}
m_mplus <- mplus_to_dsem("
  ANALYSIS: ESTIMATOR = BAYES;
  MODEL:
    %WITHIN%
    y^ ON y^1;
    y ON x;
", time = "time")
identical(m_rdsem$terms, m_mplus$terms)
```
